hero.heading: Our aim is simple. To build a collection of Home Interiors businesses that provide an amazing showroom retail experience at a competitive price.
hero.body:
Saverys of Broadway, a full interior design business serving clients in the UK and beyond for more than 50 years. With showrooms in the Heart of the Cotswolds, In the Marches and in Chelsea.

Canwell Interiors showroom in the heart of the Cotswolds with home furnishings, accessories and soft furnishings without the Cotswolds price tag.

xshowhome.com, online nationwide delivery home furnishings, accessories and soft furnishings business.

Exshowhome, new and ex-showhome furnishings, accessories and soft furnishings showroom based on a stunning vineyard near Sutton Coldfield, Birmingham.

More exciting locations coming soon.

group.heading: Providing a beautiful showroom retail experience in a relaxed environment for your home furnishing and interior design needs.
paragraphs:
The House of Canwell builds interiors brands and relationships that provide a cost conscious offering for its customers at every price point. 

Xshowhome sells nationally online and through its showroom at exceptional value. Canwell Interiors is the premium retail showroom, curated and in person. Saverys designs and makes at the high end, with its own upholstery and soft furnishing workrooms.

Each brand is strong on its own. Held together, they cover more of the market than any one of them could alone. The group owns its design and manufacturing capability and runs its own ecommerce and delivery, so margin and expertise stay in-house.

model.heading: House of Canwell is built to expand nationally to provide its offering and expertise around the UK.
paragraphs: The brands share more than an owner. Xshowhome and Canwell Interiors route bespoke and full design work to Saverys. The retail brands and the online brand buy from the same suppliers, and Saverys’ workshops can manufacture for any of them.

The result is a single group that captures demand across price points and channels, and keeps a customer inside it as their needs grow. Someone who starts with a £40 cushion online can later commission a room from the studio that makes it.
